### Seeking the Living Among the Dead - He Is Risen!
Author: Jason Soroski
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-april-12.html
Passage: Luke 24:5-7
Points:
- The women came to the tomb intending only to honor a dead body, not anticipating a miracle.
- Heaven's angels confronted them by asking why they were seeking the living among the dead.
- Believers today often make the same mistake by searching for life and hope in dead worldly systems.
- Like the women at the tomb, we frequently forget Christ's words and need to be reminded of His promises.
- Because the grave could not hold Him, death has been defeated and Jesus is forever alive.

### Rediscovering the Real Meaning of Easter
Author: Vivian Bricker
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/rediscovering-the-real-meaning-of-easter-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Matthew 28:6
Points:
- Cultural traditions and commercialism can easily distract people from the true meaning of Easter.
- The angel's declaration that Jesus has risen provides enduring hope even during our darkest times.
- Christ's victory over the grave secures redemption and eternal life for all who trust in Him.
- Celebrating the reality of the resurrection moves believers to share the good news with others.
